Arunachal Flood Damage Assessment

Union ministers and the Chief Minister of Arunachal Pradesh conducted an aerial survey to assess the damage caused by recent floods in the state. The assessment aims to determine the extent of the damage and potential needs for aid. This is a critical step in responding to the disaster, as it will inform relief efforts and recovery plans.
